subject: Re: Scaler Studio — request for promotional starter credits & invoice split
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@scalerstudio.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Scaler Studio — promo credits + split invoicing?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers for streaming chat. We're finalizing the curriculum for our October cohort and I'd like to ask if Redwood can make a one-time promotional exception for the cohort participants. Two asks: 1) a package of $1,500 in starter credits that we can distribute across ~12 teams (mostly early-stage founders), and 2) the ability to split a single invoice between Scaler Studio and individual teams (we handle a portion, they handle the rest via invoice attachments).

We can provide a roster (attached) and are happy to sign an SOW or commit to a minimum spend afterwards. For budgeting I need confirmation this week so we can include Redwood in the partner packet.

Attachments: scaler_cohort_roster.csv (roster, team names and emails)

Best,
Amy Chen
Program Director, Scaler Studio
amy@scalerstudio.org
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@scalerstudio.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaler Studio — promo credits + split invoicing?

Hi Amy — really glad the demo landed well. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying questions: we typically issue partner starter credits in $250 increments per team up to program-wide limits; a $1,500 pool is doable but I'd need to route the invoice-splitting ask through finance and legal.

Questions:
- Will the teams be on individual Redwood accounts (preferred) or under a single program master account?
- Do you need the credits issued up front or as a post-activation credit on the main invoice?

I'll loop in Ben from Partnerships and Laura from Billing to confirm the invoice mechanics and get a draft SOW over. If you can confirm the account model (master vs individual) and the desired timing, we can turn this around fast.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Scaler Studio — promo credits + split invoicing?

Looping in Laura on the billing side — Amy is proposing: $1,500 promo credit pool for ~12 teams + split invoicing where Scaler pays part and teams pay remainder. They can provide roster and an SOW.

Laura — high-level constraints: finance typically requires a single payor on an invoice; we can do invoicing addendums but splitting payments across external parties requires either (a) Scaler issues us a purchase order covering their portion and the teams pay us separately, or (b) we bill Scaler and Scaler rebates their portion to teams off-platform. There may also be tax/PO implications for sponsors.

Can we do a carve-out: issue starter credits to listed team accounts up front, and bill a consolidated invoice to Scaler for the sponsor portion, with an optional attachable invoice per team that they can pay? If that's too manual we should propose a clean SOW that clarifies responsibility.

Ben
Director, Partnerships
ben@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@scalerstudio.org>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaler Studio — promo credits + split invoicing?

Hi Amy — thanks for the roster. We can accommodate a partner-sponsored credit pool with two caveats: 1) legal needs the SOW to reference 'sponsorship credits' and define redemption rules (non-transferable, expires 90 days after issue), and 2) finance requires a primary invoiced party for accounting.

Practical approach I recommend:
- Redwood issues $1,500 in sponsorship credits and assigns them to the 12 team accounts you provided.
- Redwood issues a single invoice to Scaler Studio for the sponsor portion (e.g., $1,200) and provides each team with an invoice stub that they can use to pay their share (e.g., $25 per team) if you choose a cost-share.
- If teams prefer to pay Scaler directly, Scaler must provide a PO covering the sponsor amount and state whether Redwood should zero-balance those specific line items.

I'll attach a short SOW template (SOW-draft.pdf) and can run this through legal. If you confirm you want credits issued up front and that Scaler will be the primary invoiced party for $1,200, we'll produce the credits within 48 hours.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf
From: Amy Chen <amy@scalerstudio.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Ramos <victor@scalerstudio.org>
Date: 2026-08-09T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scaler Studio — promo credits + split invoicing?

Thanks — this flow works for us. Scaler will be primary invoiced for $1,200 and we'll issue a PO this afternoon. We want credits issued up front so teams can use them during the onboarding week (Oct 4–10). Confirming the redemption rules: non-transferable, expires 90 days after issue is fine.

Next steps:
- I'll upload the PO to your HubSpot deal and sign the short SOW (please send the DocuSign link).
- Please flag any tax forms you need from Scaler (we're US-based nonprofit).

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to getting the cohort live with Redwood in October.

Best,
Amy
Program Director, Scaler Studio
amy@scalerstudio.org
